title: Spacecraft Solar Array
definition: A spacecraft solar array is the complete assembly that converts sunlight into electrical power: photovoltaic cells and their interconnects are arranged into strings on one or more panels, with cabling, mounting hardware and any hinges, hold-down devices, release mechanisms or pointing drives. The array feeds a [[Spacecraft Electrical Power System]], which controls its operating point, stores energy and distributes power. Cell efficiency, panel power density and power delivered to a spacecraft bus describe different boundaries and should not be quoted as though they were the same.[^1][^2]
